question: According to the classical wave theory of light, the energy carried by an electromagnetic wave is distributed continuously over the wavefront. Based on this premise, what prediction did the wave theory make regarding the maximum kinetic energy of the emitted photoelectrons?

options.A: It should be independent of the intensity of light
options.B: It should increase as the intensity of the light beam increases
options.C: It should depend strictly on the frequency of the incident light
options.D: It should decrease as the wavelength of light decreases
